_readme: Single source of truth for every placeholder on both sites. Change a value here and run `node scripts/build.mjs` to regenerate dist/. Anything prefixed TODO- is not real yet and blocks go-live (see DEPLOY.md).
contactEmailNote: Real, monitored inbox as of 2026-08-21. If a domain is bought later, support@<domain> supersedes it (free forwarding - see docs/DOMAIN-HOOKUP.md); until then this is the address on every surface.
privacyEmailNote: Switched from gavinjgross@gmail.com on 2026-08-21 now the support inbox exists (that was the recorded plan). gavinjgross@gmail.com is still what the Play Store policy doc in the game repo lists - update it there at the next listing edit so the two match.
playStoreUrlNote: TODO: empty until the app is live on Google Play. Empty renders the Get it on Google Play button as a disabled 'Coming soon' state.
legalEntityNote: Confirmed by Gavin 2026-09-17: the app is published by Gavin Gross as an individual, doing business as gr0ss tech. Vault Legal-Entity.md is the record.
businessAddressNote: Confirmed by Gavin 2026-09-17. Used ONLY by the privacy policy (COPPA requires the operator's mailing address). Keep it out of every other page.
contactPhoneNote: Empty on purpose. COPPA's online notice (16 CFR 312.4(d)(1)) asks for name, address, telephone number and email; the policy has name and email today. A VoIP/Google Voice number would do. When there is one, put it here, add a "Phone:" line beside the email in content/shared/privacy-poison-hotdogs.html, and rebuild.
privacyLastUpdatedNote: Bump this to the day the rewritten policy actually goes live; the 2026-09 rewrite is the first one carrying the confirmed legal name and address.

gr0ss-tech.name: gr0ss tech
gr0ss-tech.baseUrlNote: Live free GitHub Pages URL as of 2026-08-31 (repo github.com/gr0ss/gr0ss-web, gh-pages branch = dist/). The Domain Decision card stays open - if a real domain is picked later, set it here and rebuild; the github.io URL keeps working.
gr0ss-tech.description: gr0ss tech is a one-person game studio building playful, kid-safe games for Android.
gr0ss-tech.customDomainNote: TODO: empty until Gavin registers a domain. Set this to the bare domain (e.g. gr0sstech.com) and the build emits the GitHub Pages CNAME file automatically. Cloudflare Pages ignores it. See docs/DOMAIN-HOOKUP.md.
